stats_process

ground 0

load "spice/capacitor.osdi"
load "spice/resistor.osdi"

model capacitor sp_capacitor
model resistor sp_resistor
model vsource vsource

parameters rsh=agauss(100, (100)*(5)/100, 1) vth=aunif(450m, 20m) tox=exp(agauss(log(4n), 30m, 1)) cg=1p

subckt cell (a b)
parameters cg__mm=aunif(cg, (cg)*(2)/100) vth__mm=agauss(vth, 5m, 1)
  r1 (a b) resistor r=rsh*10
  c1 (b 0) capacitor c=cg__mm*2
  v1 (b 0) vsource dc=vth__mm
ends

subckt plain (a b)
  r1 (a b) resistor r=1e3
ends

x1 (in out) cell
x2 (out 0) plain
v0 (in 0) vsource dc=1e0

control
  options rawfile="binary"
  analysis op1 op
endc
